# THE YOTTA! DIRECTORY [italic]Every site we know about, sorted by hand into the right drawer. Sites marked NEW! were added since the last relay.[/italic]
## ARTS AND ENTERTAINMENT - [netlink="The Hydrogen Line, 1420" link="hydrogenline.fm"] Frontier radio, all shift long. [color=#D01070]NEW![/color] - [netlink="YouTape" link="youtape.vhs"] Home tapes from every colony. - [netlink="Chroma Sleep" link="chromasleep.fan"] Synth-pop from the Titan methane docks. - [netlink="Rosie Ketch" link="rosieketch.music"] The Queen of the Outer Veil. - [netlink="Vex Starr" link="vexstarr.holo"] The star of Gateway General. - [netlink="Rex Maddox: Hostile Worlds" link="rexmaddox.holo"] Survival holo. Survival not guaranteed.
## NEWS AND MEDIA - [netlink="The Colony Herald" link="herald.colony.news"] Independent colony news. - [netlink="The Colony Tattler" link="colonytattler.news"] Gossip, read aloud in canteens. - [netlink="AtmoCast" link="atmocast.wx"] Colony weather. [color=#D01070]NEW![/color]
## BUSINESS AND ECONOMY - [netlink="Indentured" link="indentured.jobs"] Frontier contracts, long ones. - [netlink="eBuoy" link="ebuoy.auction"] Buy and sell across the relay. - [netlink="DropDash" link="dropdash.eats"] Food delivery. Do not ask. [color=#D01070]NEW![/color] - [netlink="Colony Classifieds" link="classifieds.colony"] The noticeboard, on a screen.
## REFERENCE - [netlink="ColonyPedia" link="colonypedia.ref"] The encyclopedia anyone can edit, until the Company does. - [netlink="VectorQuest" link="vectorquest.nav"] Maps and directions, eventually. - [netlink="SpaceGPT" link="spacegpt.ai"] The thinking machine. [color=#D01070]NEW![/color] - [netlink="The Galley Binder" link="galley.recipes"] What the galley knows.
## SOCIETY AND CULTURE - [netlink="MyBunk" link="mybunk.social"] A place for friends on the night shift. - [netlink="OreMatch" link="orematch.love"] Video dating for the mining frontier.
## GOVERNMENT - [netlink="Colony Administration" link="admin.colony.gov"] Notices from the office upstairs. - [netlink="Embassy of the United Americas" link="embassy.ua"] Consular services, slowly.
